name: Buprenorphine
dosing: Analgesic patches: variable; OST (sublingual) doses per specialist protocol. Avoid giving full opioid agonists shortly after buprenorphine in opioid-dependent patients (precipitated withdrawal)
monitoring: Respiratory monitoring, signs of withdrawal in dependent patients
pregnancy: Use in pregnancy for opioid dependence only under specialist antenatal care
sideEffects: Sedation, constipation, nausea, precipitated withdrawal risk
clinicalPearls: Partial agonist: risk of precipitated withdrawal in opioid-tolerant patients. Used for opioid substitution and some pain formulations
indication: Opioid dependence (OST), chronic pain management under specialist guidance
